member.summary:
FileStreamResult – Sends binary content to the response by using a Stream instance. Here you have a stream and want to return stream content as a file. FileContentResult – Sends the contents of a binary file to the response.Here you have a byte array and want to return byte content as a file.
MIME Types for files upload and download Below are a few examples of MIME – content types for your information.
ALL files: mimeType = "application/octet-stream";
Text File – "text/plain" PNG image – "image/png" JPEG image – "image/jpeg" MSDoc – "application/vnd.ms-word" MSDoc – "application/vnd.ms-word" PDF file – "application/pdf" Excel File- "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
